question: Does run c certify backups, remote replicas or the hardware failure probability?

criteria.instruction: No. c verifies one specified barrier sequence and recovery in the fictional model. There is no backup restore, device audit, remote-replica verification or fleet failure denominator. b remains unresolved independently.
Cite crash-journal scope and persistence evidence limits; separate live visibility, local modeled durability and broader recovery guarantees.
Decline backup/replica certification, hardware reliability percentages and universal filesystem guarantees from this experiment.
